data.body: rebar-debug Phase 1 complete; Phase 2 test contract frozen. Runtime reproduction through public adapter.code_review_decision with 11 blocking findings, each >240 chars, produced a header claiming 11 issues, exactly 10 bullets, and bullets clipped mid-token with no ellipsis/overflow disclosure. Proven changeable cause: src/rebar/review_bot/adapter.py:120 iterates blocking[:10] and line 122 slices normalized detail[:240], while lines 123-125 append/return without either disclosure branch. Alternative that another layer discloses omission is rejected: voter.py posts decision["message"] directly to Gerrit; full findings remain separately present in the adapter result. Contract authority: ticket ACs and CONTRIBUTING.md:129-135 define a finding -1 as actionable input the author fixes before repushing. Caller sweep found only adapter._block/code_review_decision and voter posting the message; no caller depends on silent clipping. Test contract: in-process public adapter tier with only produce_code_review_verdict faked; preconditions assert 11 findings and over-cap text; postconditions require an explicit clip marker, an omitted-count note, and all 11 full translated findings preserved; short/exactly-at-cap controls must not claim truncation. Gate: focused pytest node, then repository gates. No new dependency or external behavior is introduced.
